, Reason for Mistake: The Planner misinterpreted the web results and conflated Dell’s “USB PowerShare” (the correct term for keeping USB powered while off) with “USB Wake Support” (a different wake-from-USB feature), then prematurely finalized the answer as “USB Wake Support (PowerShare)” instead of the correct “PowerShare.”
